implementation.default_external_behavior: fail closed when transport, credential, or data-policy adapter is absent

execution_contracts: connector is loaded by organization, source Agent, id, enabled state and non-deleted tombstone
persisted config is fully revalidated immediately before every execution
registry, MCP and A2A require an explicit data-policy authorizer
MCP and A2A call only an injected transport; no implicit http client exists
credential headers are resolved only inside an injected adapter and are never audited
internal target Agent tenancy is revalidated immediately before invocation
schema connector validates input or output with the declared JSON Schema dialect
idempotent retries are bounded by max_attempts and total timeout
per-connector concurrency, response bytes and invocation bytes are bounded
retryable downstream failures open a per-connector circuit breaker
all terminal outcomes write minimum-necessary connector_execution_audit rows
operation, run, task, span, error code and HTTP class are allowlisted identifiers
adapter exception text, arguments, outputs, headers and credential references are not persisted

DNS-to-socket IP pinning and redirect-hop revalidation in a production transport
Vault/KMS provider adapters and OAuth2 token exchange
durable cross-worker circuit state and distributed concurrency limits
